decision: pinned on codex/within-fused-lsmr; fused step is within's default kernel

within.scope: A v, the u update and ||u|| bitwise unchanged; A'u summed in fixed design-only row lanes (sorted runs in row order, lane buffers merged in lane order, ownership index for separate terms); no adjoint atomics. StepKernel::Separate keeps efe35ee bits (24 pinned session digests).
within.determinism: fused results repeat exactly and are identical across worker counts in default and reproducible mode for Off, Diagonal and Ordered-additive preconditioners; 600,000-row test with 200,000 sorted and 120,000 unsorted levels at 1/2/4/8 workers.

fused.result: 73/73 pass with 4- and 8-worker repeats and cross-worker science; no solver-code, iteration, stop-reason or discrete change

final.result: exact vs fused plugin; scoped replay vs beta.9 73/73 pass

timing_rule: Mac Studio (Apple M2 Ultra, 16 performance + 8 efficiency cores) shared with other agents; before each process wait for 30 s without any other stata-mp, cargo, rustc or python process, watch during the run, discard a contaminated run and repeat it once; cells still contaminated got one follow-up schedule declared before the first schedule finished. Medians of all clean samples; descriptive, not qualification.

within_kernel_seconds.workload: examples/fused_step: 1,000,000 rows, 200,000 sorted workers, 10,000 firms (2% mobility), 32-level third effect, 16 RHS solve_batch, 23 steps

fereg_native_seconds.notes: Same routes and LSMR iterations; three-dense uses the MAP pilot and no LSMR. Fused e(rss) identical at 1/4/8 workers; beta.9 default mode differed in the last bits across worker counts.

memory_accounting: Per live session at n rows (unit weights): pinned 5 observation vectors (y, b, rhs, u, av); E6a 4 seeded / 3 unseeded; fused 3 seeded / 2 unseeded plus lane buffers <= n/4 values, without the per-operator atomic scatter scratch. fereg's admission (4n per active RHS plus scatter) is unchanged and remains an upper bound.
